title: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed…
description: A vulnerability exists in DNSdist when DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers. If a reverse proxy in front of DNSdist appends new X-Forwarded-For headers instead of replacing existing ones, DNSdist uses the first header rather than the last. This behavior allows a client to spoof its IP address.
